description:

Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.  
  
Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.  
  
You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team. You will own the test automation strategy and framework architecture, ensuring reliability and accuracy across complex application workflows. Embedded in Agile delivery teams alongside developers, product managers, and designers, you bring a software engineering mindset to quality problems and set the quality bar the whole team works toward.

**Primary responsibilities**

**Test strategy and technical leadership**

* Define and own the test strategy, framework architecture, and tooling roadmap for assigned product areas.
* Translate business requirements into traceable test cases across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end dimensions; lead test plan reviews with developers, product owners, and project managers.
* Define test coverage metrics and quality gates; produce risk-based release readiness reports for engineering leadership at each milestone.

**Test automation and AI-assisted engineering**

* **AI-assisted development:** Leverage GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and comparable AI coding assistants to accelerate test script authorship, generate edge-case scenarios, and perform intelligent code review.
* **AI agentic testing:** Configure and evaluate agentic workflows for autonomous test generation and self-healing locators; apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents to test tools, APIs, and data sources for end-to-end agentic test workflows; define system instructions, skills, and tool configurations for AI coding agents.
* Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity in **PostgreSQL (using DBeaver)**; build data-driven test suites for parallel and cross-browser execution.

**Defect management, collaboration, and mentorship**

* Isolate, document, and track defects in Azure DevOps; lead exploratory testing sessions and root-cause analysis on escaped defects.
* Serve as quality engineering lead across Agile delivery teams; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and retrospectives.
* Conduct code reviews and coach developers and team members on shift-left testing practices and quality engineering standards.

**Required qualifications**

**Core**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, MIS, or related discipline; 4 to 7 years in software quality engineering with the majority in test automation and framework development on a commercial product.
* Production-quality automation code in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript; proficiency with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress; API testing with REST Assured, Postman, or SoapUI.
* CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); strong Git skills; cross-browser testing with BrowserStack or equivalent; solid SQL skills for database validation.
* Deep understanding of QA lifecycle and Agile/Iterative delivery; clear communicator able to produce test strategies and quality summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience with performance engineering, scalability design, and observability practices (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) in production systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and related cloud-native tooling.

**AI and agentic development tools**

* Practical daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and review test code; proven ability to craft effective prompts and system instructions.
* Solid understanding of AI agents, skills, and tool-calling; familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — ability to connect AI models to internal tools, APIs, and test infrastructure for multi-step agentic workflows; working knowledge of an LLM API or orchestration framework (Anthropic API, LangChain, or similar) is a strong plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Performance and/or security testing (JMeter, k6, OWASP ZAP); TDD/BDD methodologies (Cucumber, Reqnroll); containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript; familiarity with Visual Studio and the Microsoft development ecosystem; ISTQB certification or equivalent credential.
* Knowledge of AWS services (SNS, S3, EC2, Lambda, etc.) is an advantage; familiarity with cloud-based test environment provisioning and infrastructure as code.

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor — the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence.

About the team. Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles.

title: Senior Software Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead automation and quality engineering for a X3 squad, turning customer and migration risks into fast, reliable evidence that supports confident releases.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Strong automation programming in TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Python or comparable languages.
  
- Experience with UI, API, GraphQL, integration, data and end-to-end test design.
  
- Strong SQL/data validation, REST/SOAP integration and batch or migration workflow testing.
  
- CI/CD, containers, test data, observability and defect analysis in a cloud-native environment.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to explain quality risk and evidence in clear English across time zones.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Automate contract and event-integration checks, secure pipeline controls, release/upgrade/rollback evidence, and migration reconciliation. Make failures observable and useful to developers; apply container or orchestration test environments when relevant to the suite.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Hands-on L4G/4GL or Progress 4GL, Crystal Reports, SQL Server/Oracle or Web/Syracuse testing.
  
- Working X3 domain knowledge and understanding of metadata, customisation and upgrade risk.
  
- Contract testing, performance testing, accessibility, security or chaos/resilience testing.
  
- Migration comparison tooling, synthetic monitoring or golden customer datasets.
  
- Cloud environments and partner certification.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 6+ years in quality engineering or software automation, with ownership of automation for a substantial product area. Degree or equivalent experience in computing, engineering or a related discipline.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- The squad has a trusted regression signal for the highest-risk customer and migration paths.
  
- Quality gates run consistently in delivery pipelines and failures are diagnosed promptly.
  
- Migration and upgrade evidence supports predictable go/no-go, hypercare exit and rollback decisions.
  
- Manual regression effort and escaped defects reduce without reducing meaningful coverage.
  
Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Software Engineers, Senior/Principal Automation Engineers, Product, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and migration/partner teams across India, Europe and North America.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Accountability, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Challenges weak evidence respectfully, follows risk to impact and helps the whole squad own quality.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Design and implement maintainable automated tests across UI, API, GraphQL, data, integration, performance and operational journeys.
  
- Own risk-based regression for an X3 domain or platform capability, including legacy-modern equivalence and customisation behaviour.
  
- Integrate tests into CI/CD quality gates and make failures diagnosable, actionable and visible to the squad.
  
- Support migration waves, upgrades and rollback rehearsals with repeatable evidence and clear exit criteria.
  
- Coach Software Automation Engineers and partner with developers early in design and implementation.
  
Decision ownership:
  
Test design and automation approach for owned scope, risk-based coverage, evidence quality and release recommendations within agreed programme guardrails.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Senior Manager - Engineering Excellence
description:
**We create possibilities that move life and commerce forward**
Welcome to Manhattan. Every day, our supply chain commerce technology connects two billion people to 20 billion consumer choices. In the warehouse, on the road and in the store, we make what was once impossible, possible. If you want to tackle complex problems and redefine markets, you’ve come to the right place.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and evolve the enterprise Test Automation and Quality Engineering strategy, roadmap and operating model.
* Establish scalable and reusable automation frameworks, engineering standards and quality practices across technology teams.
* Drive integration of automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous and reliable software delivery.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, engineering effectiveness and SDLC efficiency.
* Promote adoption and maturity of modern DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including shift\-left quality and automation.
* Define and establish engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures that provide visibility into quality, productivity, delivery effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement opportunities for AI\-assisted engineering and intelligent automation across the software development lifecycle.
* Assess existing engineering practices and help teams establish standardized processes, workflows and continuous improvement mechanisms.
* Build reusable engineering capabilities, frameworks and patterns that can be adopted across multiple teams.
* Establish and facilitate Communities of Practice to promote engineering standards, knowledge sharing and adoption of best practices.
* Build, lead and mentor a high\-performing Engineering Excellence team.
* Partner across organizational boundaries and influence engineering leaders and teams to drive sustainable adoption and measurable improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 14\+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, Test Automation, SDET or related engineering disciplines.
* Strong experience designing, implementing and scaling Test Automation / SDET / Quality Engineering capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience building reusable automation frameworks and engineering standards across multiple teams or products.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD, DevOps and cloud\-native engineering.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience leading technical teams and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries.
* Experience establishing or using engineering metrics, KPIs and maturity measures to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior engineering and technology leaders.
* Ability to translate complex engineering challenges into practical, scalable and measurable solutions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience establishing or leading an Engineering Excellence, Quality Engineering, Test Automation or Engineering Productivity capability.
* Exposure to DevSecOps, developer experience and platform engineering practices.
* Experience with engineering maturity assessments and continuous\-improvement frameworks.
* Practical experience applying Generative AI, AI\-assisted development/testing or intelligent automation within the SDLC.
* Experience establishing Communities of Practice or enterprise\-wide engineering standards.
* Experience working across globally distributed engineering organizations.
* Familiarity with modern cloud platforms, automation technologies and engineering toolchains.

**Leadership Expectations**

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on engineering leader and capability builder who can operate across strategy and execution.
* They should be comfortable working with engineering teams at a technical level while also partnering with senior leaders to drive organizational change, establish standards and demonstrate measurable improvements.
* The role requires someone who can influence without relying solely on organizational authority, build credibility with engineering teams and progressively raise engineering maturity across the organization.

**Measures of Success**


Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvements such as:

* Increased adoption and coverage of automated testing.
* Reduced regression and release\-validation effort.
* Improved integration of automated quality gates within CI/CD.
* Reduction in escaped defects and repeat quality issues.
* Improved engineering productivity and delivery effectiveness.
* Adoption of common engineering standards and reusable capabilities.
* Establishment of meaningful engineering metrics and maturity measures.
* Increased adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices.
* Demonstrable improvement in engineering maturity across participating teams.
